annotations.title: Find the cheapest verified GLP-1 route

description: The cheapest verified way to get a GLP-1 in a given US state, optionally for one drug and on a cash or insured basis. Returns the winner and the next two cheapest.

cash_or_insured.description: How the person is paying. Default "cash".

drug.description: Optional drug. One of: wegovy, zepbound, ozempic, mounjaro, rybelsus, sema_compounded, tirz_compounded, liraglutide. Plain names such as "compounded semaglutide" are accepted.

state.description: Two-letter code or state name, e.g. "TX" or "Texas". Optional.
